{{Short description|Italian physical chemist}}
'''Ugo Bardi''' (born 23 May 1952 in [[Florence, Italy]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cge.uevora.pt/aspo2005/biographies.php|title=ASPO 2005 IV International Workshop on Oil and Gas Depletion – Biographies|work=cge.uevora.pt|publisher=[[University of Évora]]|accessdate=1 February 2013|archive-date=17 July 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120717041149/http://www.cge.uevora.pt/aspo2005/biographies.php|url-status=dead}}{{nonspecific|date=November 2020}}</ref>) is a professor of physical chemistry at the [[University of Florence]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Ugo Bardi |url=https://www.unifi.it/cercachi-per-2472.html |website=Università degli Studi di Firenze |accessdate=17 November 2020}}</ref>

==Career==
Bardi is a researcher on materials for new energy sources and a contributor to the now-defunct website, "[[The Oil Drum]]". He is the co-founder and former president of ASPO Italy, a member of the scientific committee of the {{ill|Association for the Study of Peak Oil and Gas|it|ASPO}} (ASPO),<ref>{{cite web |last1=Campbell |first1=Colin J. |title=About ASPO |url=https://www.peakoil.net/about-aspo |website=Peak Oil |accessdate=17 November 2020 |date=14 February 2008 |archive-date=18 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210118200308/https://www.peakoil.net/about-aspo |url-status=dead }}</ref> a member of the [[Club of Rome]],<ref>{{cite web |title=Ugo Bardi | website=Club of Rome | accessdate=1 June 2021|url=https://www.clubofrome.org/member/bardi-ug/}}</ref> and author of several books, including ''The Limits to Growth Revisited''.

== Personal life ==
Bardi was married in 1976 to his wife, Grazia, and is a father of two, Francesco and Donata.
